method: Static mounted ovals compared with released 0.2.27. Source-native mount bounds retained; no geometry fit applied. Scan poses use only frame boundaries. Ordinary M21 rows replay their published poses. Private planeswalker templates remain diagnostic, with rejected scans retained for review. No production score upload.
normalization: Ordinary M21 replays existing validated poses. Planeswalkers use independent strips from a fixed median of six M15 scans, excluding all lettering, artwork, stamps and loyalty badges. Five failed frame fits remain excluded, including the older unstamped control. These diagnostic templates do not certify planeswalker whole-card scoring.
ovalMethod: Positive-inward contrast on the side/lower ellipse perimeter. Upper colored arc and angle-dependent interior are excluded; 72 angular samples, at least 75% positive support and mean contrast 30/255. Native source bounds retained without fitting card-specific renderer values.
limitations: Static source hologram differs from scan lighting and pattern; animation is pending.
Four of fourteen ordinary structural scores fall; largest regression is Vito at 0.9 points, from flavor-text wrapping after reserving oval clearance. Keep as a typography outlier.
Other security-stamp shapes are metadata only.
No claim of general cross-set scoring coverage from the finite ordinary sample.

decodeAudit.explanation: Initial source preview borrowed the 0.2.27 asset loader, which enlarged planeswalker mounts to 768px. Actual 0.2.28 uses native 182px. Rechecked all 30 with each painter own loader: source and release pixels are identical; differences from initial preview are confined to mounted stamp rectangles and the six previously unpatched M15 set symbols. Ordinary cards and unstamped controls are unchanged. Original candidate evidence is retained.
